headline: Yen Rises as Markets React to Oil, AI and French Political Concerns
summary: The Japanese yen climbed as currency markets responded to global concerns regarding oil prices, artificial intelligence sector valuations, and political developments in France.
why: The Japanese yen is widely viewed as a traditional safe-haven currency during periods of global economic uncertainty or risk aversion across international financial markets.

impacts.name: USD/JPY
impacts.why: Safe-haven flows into the yen increased amid broader cross-market concerns.

why_moved: Heightened caution across global equities and commodities spurred safe-haven demand for the Japanese currency.
